defs.def: similar in every detail 完全同样的；相同的

ex.s: However, psychologists have demonstrated that when adults read news stories, they remember more of the content than if they listen to or view identical pieces.
ex.t: 然而，心理学家已经证明，当成年人阅读新闻故事时，比起聆听或观看相同的片段，他们对内容的记忆更多。

ex.s: However, for maximizing learning where mental focus and reflection are called for, educators shouldn’t assume all media are the same, even when they contain identical words.
ex.t: 然而，在需要专注与思考、追求学习效果最大化时，教育者不应认为所有媒介都是一样的，即使它们包含相同的文字。

ex.s: I only used to have five identical pairs of trousers and five identical shirts.
ex.t: 我以前只有五条一模一样的裤子和五件一模一样的衬衫。

ex.s: In France, a person encountering an identical gesture may interpret it as meaning zero.
ex.t: 在法国，遇到相同手势的人可能会将其解释为零。

ex.s: It is in every way identical to sheep B, but younger.
ex.t: 它在各方面都与羊B完全相同，但更年轻。

ex.s: It also happens in animals when identical twins are produced from the same egg.
ex.t: 当双胞胎由同一个卵子产生时，在动物身上也会发生这种情况。

ex.s: Another example of natural cloning is identical twins, who are produced from the same egg.
ex.t: 自然克隆的另一个例子是同卵双胞胎，他们由同一个卵子产生。
